title.narrative: Standing up Against Violence (STAV)

description.narrative: STAV seeks to combat a rise in violence during the COVID19 pandemic committed against LGBTI persons, sex workers and indigent people facing situations of land grabbing in Uganda through increasing access to justice in incidences of violence, increasing the generation and use of quality evidence to advocate against violence and improving the legal and policy environment for the protection and promotion of rights.
